main_text.p: ἐθω εἶθον, consuesco, bam: usitatum in εἴωθα consuevi, & εἰώθειν consueveram.
ἔπω εἶπον, dico, bam, poëtis: oratoribus autem usitatum duntaxat in aoristis: Et augmentum in derivatis ubiq; servatur, εἶπα, εἶπαμεν: εἶπον, εἰπόμεν, εἶπε, εἶπειν, εἶπων ον-

page.notes: Greek transcription is approximate; several accents and breathings on the verb forms are uncertain. The final line is a catchword-like fragment "κ" printed below the text and is left as printed.
